summary: QMMM Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) disclosing that on October 28, 2026 its Board, Nominating Committee and Compensation Committee approved the appointment of Ms. Hui-ling Chen as an independent non-employee director, effective immediately, with annual compensation of US$18,000, serving until a successor is elected or her earlier death, resignation or removal. The Board determined she is independent under SEC and Nasdaq rules and an audit committee financial expert; she chairs the compensation committee and sits on audit and governance/nominating committees. No family relationships or special-situation terms exist; this is a routine board appointment, not an abrupt or forced departure. No deal terms, premium, advisor or regulatory clock apply; no risk-arb angle.
